title: SAMM / Catena-X Pipeline Pattern

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They know RML/YARRRML and want to understand the two-stage SPARQL CONSTRUCT pattern used for Catena-X.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: Why two stages are needed for SAMM models, how the SPARQL INSERT pattern works, how to replicate it for their domain.
steps: Why SAMM needs two stages — SAMM structure doesn't map directly to PMDco; intermediate RDF step needed
Stage 1: YARRRML mapping to Catena-X namespace (intermediate RDF)
Inline: first 15 lines of a real PA6GF30 YARRRML mapping showing SAMM prefixes
Stage 2: SPARQL CONSTRUCT bridging intermediate to PMDco
Inline: SPARQL INSERT structure for one property (from samm-idta-pipeline-patterns.json)
Live example: PA6GF30 dataset on futurecarproduction.materialsdata.space
Trigger mechanism: browser helper page (not automated) — explicit note
When to use this pattern vs. direct YARRRML/RML

inline_assets_required.description: First 15 lines of a real PA6GF30 YARRRML mapping showing SAMM prefixes and CX namespace. Fetch from futurecarproduction.materialsdata.space mappings group or use samm-idta-pipeline-patterns.json sparql_insert_structure.
SPARQL CONSTRUCT/INSERT snippet showing one property bridge: CX intermediate → PMDco. Use concrete_example_pa6gf30.sparql_insert_structure from spec.

walkthrough_requirements.step: Find a PA6GF30 dataset on live instance
walkthrough_requirements.expected: Dataset with YARRRML mapping resource in mappings group

walkthrough_requirements.step: Fetch the mapping YAML URL from the dataset
walkthrough_requirements.expected: YARRRML with samm: prefix visible in prefixes block

quality_gate: Two-stage pattern explained with clear stage 1 / stage 2 division
Inline YARRRML snippet shows real SAMM prefix
Trigger mechanism (browser helper, not automated) stated explicitly
notes: samm-idta-pipeline-patterns.json has concrete_example_pa6gf30.sparql_insert_structure with 4 node types per property and 13 properties mapped — use as primary inline source. Two-path comparison table is in spec as two_path_comparison. Execution mechanism: NOT automated — browser helper page.

primary.name: Data Engineer
knows: Tabular data and data transformation concepts
does_not_know: RDF, triples, or the semantic web stack
YARRRML, RML, or any mapping language
What a named graph or blank node is
primary.goal: Connect data sources, author mappings, and query transformation results.
primary.key_gap: Solid general engineering skills but semantic web is completely foreign. Every RDF/SPARQL/YARRRML concept must be explained from first principles — do not assume any prior semantic knowledge.

secondary.name: Domain Scientist
secondary.goal: Upload their data, trigger the pipeline, and use or export FAIR-compliant results.
